$comment: yt-dlp arguments shared by companion/pipeline.py (downloads) and companion/lookup.mjs (B4 lookups). 'base' goes on every invocation; 'lookup' is added for metadata-only lookups (architecture §6.10 CPA); --ignore-no-formats-error because a lookup needs only id, title, duration and thumbnails, never a playable format. pipeline.py keeps a fallback copy of 'base' (FALLBACK_YTDLP_ARGS) for a processor built without this file; companion/lookup.test.mjs checks the two match.
